title: 第11章 神兽第12章 夜沉风凛情迷夜
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
自从昨晚的经历之后，杨欢发现，每当他尝试着调动起体内那股神秘的暖流时。
一种奇异的感觉便会涌上心头，他的听力和视觉瞬间变得敏锐无比。
仿佛整个世界都在他的感知下变得清晰起来，
所有的细微声响和微小动静都逃不过他的耳朵和眼睛。
这种感觉对他来说很新奇。
他心中暗自思忖，不太确定这究竟是那套不知名功法的奇妙功效，还是因为吸纳了九尾狐精元后所带来的特殊加持。
不过，无论原因是什么，这无疑是一件对他极为有利的事情。
杨欢怀着一丝好奇与警惕，小心翼翼地靠近悬崖边缘，朝着下方望去。
只见在那云雾缭绕的悬崖之下，两只模样怪异的巨兽正在激烈地搏斗着。
它们的每一次攻击和闪避都带起一阵狂风，将周围的草木吹得东倒西歪，沙石漫天飞扬。
其中一只巨兽身形矫健，通体雪白。
外形有些像马，但又比马多了几分威严与神秘的气息。
它的头角上长着一只锋利的独角，在阳光的照耀下闪烁着清冷的光芒。
那模样竟与杨欢前世在神话传说中听闻的独角兽有几分相似。
独角兽的四蹄不停地刨动着地面，激起一片片尘土。
它的双眼闪烁着愤怒的红光，紧紧盯着眼前的对手。
口中不时发出低沉的咆哮声，仿佛在向对方示威。
而它的对手，则是一只形状奇特的怪物，体型庞大而笨重，有点像水牛，却又浑身散发着一股让人胆寒的阴森气息，隐隐约约竟给人一种像是传说中叫啮鉄的怪兽的感觉。
它的皮肤漆黑如墨，仿佛是由最深沉的夜色凝聚而成，在那黑暗的表皮上，还生长着一层金色的绒毛，在风中摇曳着，闪烁着诡异的光芒。
啮鉄的头部宽阔而扁平，两只巨大的眼睛犹如燃烧的绿火，透露出无尽的贪婪与凶残。

最让人毛骨悚然的是，它的嘴巴里长满了尖锐的獠牙，每一颗都仿佛能够轻易地撕裂钢铁。
在啮鉄的攻击下，独角兽的身上已经出现了几道触目惊心的伤口，鲜血淋漓，染红了周围的地面。
杨欢看到这一幕，心中不禁暗暗吃惊。
他深知，这两只怪物绝非等闲之辈，无论是独角兽那神秘而强大的气息，还是啮鉄那恐怖的外形和凶残的攻击手段，都让他感受到了一种前所未有的压力。
杨欢目光紧紧地锁定在下方那激烈搏斗的两只巨兽身上，眼睛一眨不眨，看得愈发仔细了起来。
就在这时，他忽然注意到，在那头威风凛凛却又伤痕累累的独角兽身后，还蜷缩着一只小小的身影。
那竟是一只模样袖珍的独角兽幼崽，身形大概只有成人手臂长短，模样娇小可爱，与它那高大威武的母亲相比，显得尤为弱小无助。
瞧那情形，显然前面那体型庞大的独角兽便是这小独角兽的母亲，此刻它正拼尽全力与那恐怖的啮鉄搏斗着，想必就是为了保护自己身后这尚还年幼、毫无抵抗之力的孩子。
看到这一幕，杨欢的心像是被什么东西轻轻地揪了一下，不由自主地涌起了一阵恻隐之心。
他深知，无论是在前世还是这神秘莫测的世界，母爱都是如此的伟大。
为了守护自己的孩子，哪怕是面对再强大的敌人，做母亲的都会毫不犹豫地冲上前去，用自己的身躯为孩子撑起一片安全的天地。
杨欢的目光顺着悬崖向下探去，粗略估量了一下距离，发现那两只怪兽所在的位置距离悬崖顶大概有二十丈左右的高度。
这么高的距离，若是直接跳下去，且不说那摔下去的冲击力自己能否承受得住，单是途中万一撞到突出的岩石之类的，恐怕都得落得个重伤甚至性命不保的下场。
正有些焦急无奈之时，他眼角的余光忽然瞥见旁边有一棵生长得极为粗壮的大树。
那大树的藤蔓犹如一条条蜿蜒的巨蟒，从悬崖之上垂落下去，一直延伸到下方云雾缭绕之处，也不知道扎根在何处。
杨欢看着那藤蔓，心里不知为何竟鬼使神差地涌起一股冲动，生出了想要下去帮助那独角兽的想法。
或许是那股伟大的母爱触动了他内心深处最柔软的地方，又或许是骨子里那股路见不平的侠义劲儿被激发了出来。
总之，他此刻心意已决，无论如何都想试一试，不能眼睁睁地看着独角兽母子陷入绝境。
想到这儿，杨欢咬了咬牙，不再犹豫，连忙快步走到那棵大树旁，伸手紧紧抓住那根巨大的树藤。
他先是用力拽了拽，确认树藤足够结实后，便手脚并用，小心翼翼却又动作敏捷地沿着树藤开始往悬崖下方攀爬起来。

而此时，悬崖下方的那两只怪兽依旧在激烈地缠斗着，它们全然不知悬崖之上正有一个人顺着藤蔓朝着它们的方向赶来。
当杨欢沿着那根粗壮的树藤，历经艰辛终于抵达悬崖底部时，映入眼帘的是一幅惊心动魄的惨烈画面。
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
只见那只独角兽虽身姿依旧矫健，却已遍体鳞伤，鲜血淋漓，身上的雪白毛发被染得通红，气息也变得微弱而急促，显然在与啮鉄的激烈交锋中渐渐不支，已然被逼至绝境。
而此时，那只凶狠残暴的啮鉄似乎也察觉到了胜利在望。
content_en:
After last night's experience, Yang Huan discovered that whenever he tried to mobilize the mysterious warmth in his body.
A strange feeling will come to his heart, and his hearing and vision will instantly become extremely sharp.
It was as if the whole world became clear under his perception,
All the little sounds and movements cannot escape his ears and eyes.
This feeling was new to him.
He was thinking secretly, not sure whether this was the miraculous effect of the unknown set of techniques, or the special blessing brought by absorbing the nine-tailed fox spirit Yuan Empress.
However, no matter what the reason is, this is undoubtedly a thing that is extremely beneficial to him.
With a trace of curiosity and vigilance, Yang Huan cautiously approached the edge of the cliff and looked down.
I saw two strange-looking giant beasts fighting fiercely under the mist-shrouded cliff.
Every attack and dodge they made brought up a gust of wind, blowing the surrounding vegetation to and fro, and sending sand and rocks flying all over the sky.
One of the giant beasts has a strong body and is completely white.
It looks a bit like a horse, but it has a bit more majesty and mystery than a horse.
There is a sharp horn on the corner of its head, which shines coldly in the sunlight.
The appearance was somewhat similar to the unicorn that Yang Huan had heard about in myths and legends in his previous life.
The four hooves of the unicorn kept pawing the ground, stirring up patches of dust.
Its eyes flashed with angry red light as it stared at the opponent in front of it.
From time to time, a low roar came out of his mouth, as if to demonstrate to the other party.
Its opponent was a monster with a strange shape. It was huge and bulky, a bit like a buffalo, but it exuded a frightening and sinister aura. It vaguely gave people the feeling of being like a legendary monster called a gnat.
Its skin is as black as ink, as if it is condensed from the deepest night. On that dark surface, there is a layer of golden fluff growing, swaying in the wind, shining with a strange light.
The head of the Jietie is broad and flat, and its two huge eyes are like burning green fire, revealing endless greed and ferocity.
The most chilling thing is that its mouth is full of sharp fangs, each of which seems to be able to easily tear steel.
Under the attack of the gnat, several shocking wounds appeared on the unicorn's body, dripping with blood and dyeing the surrounding ground red.
When Yang Huan saw this scene, he couldn't help but be secretly surprised.
He knew that these two monsters were by no means ordinary people. Whether it was the mysterious and powerful aura of the unicorn or the terrifying appearance and ferocious attack methods of the rodent, he felt an unprecedented pressure.
Yang Huan's eyes were firmly fixed on the two giant beasts fighting fiercely below, and he watched more and more carefully without blinking.
At this moment, he suddenly noticed that behind the majestic but scarred unicorn, there was a small figure curled up.
It was actually a miniature unicorn cub, about the length of an adult's arm. It looked petite and cute. Compared with its tall and mighty mother, it looked particularly weak and helpless.
Looking at the situation, it is obvious that the huge unicorn in front is the mother of this little unicorn. At this moment, it is trying its best to fight against the terrifying rodent, presumably to protect the still young and defenseless child behind it.
Seeing this scene, Yang Huan's heart seemed to be gently tugged by something, and a burst of compassion surged up involuntarily.
He knew that maternal love was so great whether in his previous life or in this mysterious world.
In order to protect her children, no matter how powerful the enemy is, a mother will rush forward without hesitation and use her body to support a safe world for her children.
Yang Huan looked down the cliffI went there, roughly estimated the distance, and found that the location of the two monsters was about twenty feet away from the top of the cliff.
If you jump from such a high distance, not to mention whether you can withstand the impact of the fall, if you hit a protruding rock or the like on the way, you may be seriously injured or even lose your life.
Just when he was feeling a little anxious and helpless, from the corner of his eye, he suddenly caught a glimpse of an extremely thick tree growing next to him.
The vines of the big tree were like winding pythons, hanging down from the cliff, extending to the cloud-shrouded place below, and no one knew where they took root.
Yang Huan looked at the vines, and somehow an impulse surged in his heart, and he had the idea of ​​going down to help the unicorn.
Perhaps it was the great mother's love that touched the softest place in his heart, or perhaps the chivalrous spirit in his bones that saw rough roads was aroused.
In short, he had made up his mind at the moment and wanted to give it a try no matter what. He couldn't just watch the unicorn mother and her son fall into dire straits.
Thinking of this, Yang Huan gritted his teeth, no longer hesitated, and quickly walked to the big tree, reaching out and grabbing the huge vine tightly.
He first pulled hard, and after confirming that the vine was strong enough, he then used his hands and feet to carefully but quickly start climbing along the vine to the bottom of the cliff.
At this time, the two monsters below the cliff were still fighting fiercely. They had no idea that there was a person on the cliff coming towards them along the vines.
When Yang Huan followed the thick tree vine and finally reached the bottom of the cliff after many hardships, he saw a thrilling and tragic scene.

Although the unicorn was still strong and strong, it was covered in bruises and dripping with blood. The snow-white hair on its body was dyed red, and its breath became weak and rapid. It was obvious that it was gradually dying in the fierce battle with the rodent and had been forced into a desperate situation.
At this time, the ferocious and cruel rodent seemed to realize that victory was in sight.
